entries.0bd54e6a4f094730: A document that listed companies and others submit under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act within 3 months after the end of a fiscal year. It describes the company's overview, state of business, state of accounting and other matters, and can be read on the Financial Services Agency's EDINET.
